title: 第十四章：兄弟情（下）
content_zh:
这一刻，贺峰的心在颤抖，他的眼睛也不再如先前那样明亮，有些雾。

    就是这个和自己经常相互打闹、嘲讽甚至挖苦的胖子；这个不过就是朝自己身上喷了口茶水，就在哈哈大笑中，心甘情愿为自己打头阵的胖子；这个就算是被自己打倒在地，宁愿蜷身抱头也不站起来还手的胖子；这个隐隐间有些怕自己，却又天天跟自己腻在一块儿，事事以自己为首的胖子；就是这么个跟自己说“打虎亲兄弟”，又跟自己讲“有祸当同抗，有福亦共享”的胖子；就这么个惯会装痴扮傻、插科打诨的胖子，在那边为自己拦住了两个最难对付的两个敌人，正在为了自己挨着揍。

    贺峰，一个曾经一世孤苦的流浪子，何曾懂得什么是情？又哪里明白什么是爱？又何曾得到过这些？！但现在，他得到了远超前世所渴望的东西！他拥有了前世想都不敢想，就连做梦都不敢梦到却又渴望梦到的所有！他不再孤苦无依，他不再是无根的浮萍，他何曾想过，又何时敢想过，自己也能过上如此幸福而又惬意的日子？！可是，也是现在，他竟然眼睁睁的看着自己最为珍贵的，最视若珍宝的东西，正在被人无情的蹂躏，而他却只能在旁边看着，无能为力，无论是主动，还是被动，这都不是贺峰所能接受的结果！更不是贺峰所不能容忍的结果！

    贺峰的呼吸比起刚才又粗重了些，天空也变得更暗了些，周围沸腾嘶吼的人群，让他的血液开始狂傲的奔腾，仿佛间，他又回到了那个地下擂台。胸口不断的起伏着，鼻头也出了些细密的汗珠，紧握的拳头，指甲扎进肉里，有血缓缓从指缝中渗出，又在指节慢慢汇聚成血滴，最终滴落，狠狠地摔在了地上。但现在，又会有谁去理会一滴血珠到底摔成了几瓣呢？把敌人摔倒在地上，让敌人再也站不起来，让敌人们以后见了自己就开始发自内心的颤抖，这才是他们想要的，也才是他们希望看到的，也只有这样的结果，才能让他们开怀的大笑、大吃、大喝。

    韦明和金道将贺峰夹在中间之后，并没有给贺峰多少恢复力气的时间，更加没有给贺峰思考对策的机会，韦明率先欺身上前，想要一把抱住贺峰贺峰，然后再把他摔倒在地上，不得不说，虽然这种方法很是笨拙，但却很有效。不过，在韦明动的同时，贺峰也动了，若比力气，贺峰本就要比韦明稍大，若比爆发力，金灿都未必能胜得过此时的贺峰，更何况是韦明？

    不过，贺峰动的方向却是正躺在地上的装死的金钟，贺峰猛地向前一窜，担忧好像力气已经用尽一般，速度开始迅速变慢，而一直在一旁还未动手的金道却是已经跟了上来，不过却也没有跟得太紧，只是大喊了一声：“哥”，便再没下文。

    若是现在贺峰还看不透其中的玄机，那他前世的三十多年就算是活到狗身上了，不过在心念电转间，贺峰却有些困惑，纵观他们前后的反应以及应对，很显然，他们不仅经过谋划，而且基本上把各种会遇到的情况都进行了一番算计，他们为何会读自己如此重视？不过，这些都不是现在需要考虑的问题，只是尽管这样，他们还是算漏了，贺峰根本没有想过要去攻击让在地上的金钟，他的目标一直都是金道而已，前跑的速度当然也是故意放慢的。

    就在离金钟还有三步的时候，贺峰又故技重施，猛然转身，借助反震之力，猛地反向冲刺，抬膝，狠狠的撞向金道的肚子，前面就说过，若比爆发力，在场众人，就算是金灿也是稍有逊色，而现在，不禁要加上前跑又猛然转身的反震之力，更是要加上金道的前冲之力，贺峰有绝对的把握，一击若中，金道至少三天之内下不了床。

    就在这时，刚才扑了个空的韦明已然跟了上来，而刚才还躺在地上装死的金钟，更是猛的一跃而起，朝着贺峰这边围了过来，这一击，就算击中，也会被韦明与金钟重新包围。搭箭引弓，弦满拉，由不得贺峰再有别的选择。

    一击即中，但贺峰并没有因此而稍有停留，因为他已经看到了地上的影子在快速的靠近着自己，而且是从空中。

    贺峰就地一滚，向着旁边滚了开来，好机会！贺峰正愁着一旦被韦明和金钟二人前后夹击，胜负大局基本上就算是定下来，但现在金钟自以为势在必得的一扑，让贺峰抓到了空子，尽管很危险，但看到那边眼见就快要支撑不住的李纯，这个险，由不得贺峰不冒。

    好在贺峰也只是来得及滚上两圈，金钟便一扑而至，这个距离刚刚好，又是故技重施，猛地跃起，不过这次可不是抬膝，而是抬肘，重击金钟的侧腰，同样的，一击若中，贺峰有信心让金钟彻底失去战斗力。这一切发生的都太快了，不过是电光火石之间，不管他们之前想的多么周全，金钟也完全反应不过来，他只觉得自己刚落地，贺峰的肘击便紧随而至，毕竟三十多年养成的战斗意识，还不是现在一个小孩子所能比拟的。

    不过，贺峰来不及高兴，因为现在的角色已经开始调换了，贺峰变成了依然趴在自己身下的金钟，而韦明则变成了之前的贺峰，只是就算韦明反应的及时，但终究还是比贺峰慢了半拍，半拍的时间，对贺峰来说，足够了。

    一切的胜负便在于此了，在这一击当中谁能撑到最后，谁就能够掌握主动，这是致命的一击，一击绝杀。

    贺峰面对这快如闪电，猛若奔雷的重击，并没有向大家想象中的向外面滚开，而是向着韦明的方向翻了个身，刚好躺在了韦明的腋下，然后屈膝挡在胸前，似乎是想要用自己曲起的双腿，来挡住韦明势在必得攻向胸口的重击一般。面对贺峰如此幼稚的想法，韦明双眼满是嘲讽之色，悄然间，嘴角已经勾起了弧度。还真是个不懂事的小子，难道以为这样就能挡住自己的肘击？就算挡住又如何，弯曲的双腿在这重压之下，难道还能丝毫不伤？就算最后是两败俱伤，你们也输定了！

    相比起来，贺峰的眼神之中则是满满的郑重之色，虽然力量确实要比韦明大上一些，但是身体上的差距毕竟还是有些大了，哪怕他是惯用此招的老手，尽管知道腋下是人体无法锻炼到的软肉之一，但也不得不凝神戒备，小心翼翼。

    终于，韦明的重击落了下来，就在韦明触到贺峰膝盖的同时，贺峰立即猛地一蹬腿，将腿伸直，摊在地上。如此一来，不但将韦明下落的重击缓了下来，而且自身也还没有什么伤害，这自是贺峰多方研究出来的“见招拆招”，毕竟无论是在街头摸爬还是在擂台上滚打，多掌握一些拆招的诀窍，便能立于不败之地，当然，立于不败之地的最高境界是一直压着敌人打，直到敌人倒地不起为止，但是“常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋”，保不齐哪天被压着打的那个人就无情的变成自己了，这不，现在的贺峰就是被压着打的那个了。

    “啊！”韦明只觉得腋下犹如被烈火炙烤过一般，火辣辣的疼，一时之间，这半边身子竟用不上力，只好一直躺在地上。

    “哼！”而贺峰虽然没有像韦明疼的那样厉害，但也禁不住重哼了一声，不过并没有受什么伤，只是这一连串的斗智斗勇下来，贺峰的心神、体力都损耗颇大，但现在情况容不得休息，要知道，胖子还在那边挨着揍呢，现在的贺峰也只得深吸几口气，调整了一下自己的状态，便立即坐了起来。贺峰当然知道，这种极度劳累的时刻，哪怕只是稍歇那么一瞬，在想要起来，那便是千难万难了。

    贺峰的腿又是一蜷，韦明立马一边呼痛，一边滚了下来，而贺峰为了绝对保证韦明没有再次参加战斗的可能，站起来后，又狠狠地在刚才用膝盖顶的那半边身子猛踢了好几脚，要不是最后想起旁边还有个裁判看着，估计他又会想前天那样，“掐死|”韦明给金灿和云鸿飞看看。

    不理满地打滚喊痛的韦明，径直向最后的两个人走了过去，其实那边的三人，一直都注意着贺峰这边的战况，金灿与云鸿飞也早就想要过来，但却无奈于今天的李纯好像不要命了一般，死死的缠着他们两个，就是不让他们两个有走开的机会，对这个突然之间变得如此难缠的李纯，两人当然是极气、气极！想当初自己六人对这胖子随便拳打脚踢，也没见有这般难缠，而如今竟然拖了二人这许久，直到那边的战斗结束，这边的胖子居然还很坚强的挺立着，这让他们如何不急，又如何不气？！

    明天继续三更、求票、求票、再求票
content_en:
At this moment, He Feng's heart was trembling, and his eyes were no longer as bright as before, and were a little foggy.
This is the fat man who often fights, taunts and even sarcastically fights with each other; this fat man who just spits tea on him and laughs, willing to take the lead for him; this fat man who even if he is knocked to the ground, would rather curl up and hold his head than stand up to fight back; this fat man is vaguely afraid of himself, but every dayThe fat man who was tired of being with him and always put himself first in everything; the fat man who told himself that he was a "brother who fights tigers" and also said to himself that "we should fight together when there are misfortunes, and share the blessings together"; just such a fat man who was accustomed to pretending to be stupid and making jokes, and he had stopped the two most difficult enemies for himself, and they were being beaten for him.
He Feng, a wanderer who had been lonely all his life, how did he ever know what love is?How do you understand what love is?How have you ever gotten these?!But now, he got something far beyond what he longed for in his previous life!He has everything that he never dared to imagine in his previous life, and that he never even dared to dream about but yet desires to dream about!He was no longer lonely and helpless, he was no longer a rootless duckweed. How had he ever thought, and when had he dared to think, that he could live such a happy and comfortable life?!However, now, he actually watched his most precious thing, the thing he regarded as a treasure, being ruthlessly ravaged, but he could only watch from the side, helpless. Whether it was active or passive, this was not a result that He Feng could accept!It's not a result that He Feng can't tolerate!
He Feng's breathing was heavier than before, and the sky became darker. The roaring crowd around him made his blood start to rush arrogantly. It was as if he was back in the underground arena again.His chest was rising and falling, and there were some beads of sweat on his nose. His clenched fists, nails dug into the flesh, blood slowly seeped out from between the fingers, and slowly gathered into blood droplets on the knuckles, and finally dripped down, and he fell hard to the ground.But now, who would care about how many pieces a drop of blood broke into?Throw the enemy to the ground so that they can never stand up again, and let the enemies start to tremble from the bottom of their hearts when they see you in the future. This is what they want and what they hope to see. Only this result can make them laugh, eat and drink happily.
After Wei Ming and Jin Dao sandwiched He Feng in the middle, they did not give He Feng much time to recover his strength, let alone a chance for He Feng to think of countermeasures. Wei Ming took the lead and bullied He Feng, trying to hug He Feng and then throw him to the ground. It must be said that although this method was very clumsy, it was very effective.However, when Wei Ming moved, He Feng also moved. In terms of strength, He Feng was slightly bigger than Wei Ming. In terms of explosive power, Jin Can might not be able to beat He Feng at this time, let alone Wei Ming?
However, the direction He Feng moved was Jin Zhong, who was lying on the ground pretending to be dead. He Feng jumped forward suddenly, worried as if his strength had been exhausted, and his speed began to slow down rapidly. Jin Dao, who had been at the side but had not yet made a move, had already followed, but he did not follow too closely. He just shouted: "Brother" and said nothing more.
If He Feng still couldn't see through the mystery, then he would have lived like a dog for more than thirty years in his previous life. However, in his mind, He Feng was a little confused. Looking at their reactions and responses, it was obvious that they not only planned, but also basically calculated all the situations they would encounter. Why did they take him so seriously?However, these are not issues that need to be considered now, but despite this, they still missed it. He Feng never thought about attacking Jin Zhong, who was lying on the ground. His target was always Jin Dao, and of course his running speed was deliberately slowed down.
Just three steps away from the golden bell, He Feng repeated his old trick, turned around suddenly, and with the help of the force of the counter-shock, he sprinted in the opposite direction, raised his knees, and slammed into Jin Dao's stomach. As I said before, if it was more explosive, everyone present would be shocked.Even Jin Can was slightly inferior, but now, he couldn't help but add the counter-shock force of running forward and turning around suddenly, and even more so, Jin Dao's forward force. He Feng was absolutely sure that if one hit, Jin Dao would not be able to get out of bed for at least three days.
At this moment, Wei Ming, who had just missed, had already followed, and Jin Zhong, who had been lying on the ground just now, pretending to be dead, suddenly jumped up and surrounded He Feng. Even if this attack hit, Wei Ming and Jin Zhong would be surrounded again.With the arrow drawn and the bow drawn, He Feng had no other choice.
The blow was a hit, but He Feng did not stop for a moment, because he had already seen the shadow on the ground approaching him quickly, and from the air.
He Feng rolled on the spot and rolled away to the side, what a great opportunity!He Feng was worried that if Wei Ming and Jin Zhong were to attack him from both sides, the outcome would basically be decided. But now Jin Zhong thought he was bound to win, allowing He Feng to seize the opportunity. Although it was dangerous, seeing Li Chun who was about to lose his strength, He Feng had no choice but to take this risk.
Fortunately, He Feng only had time to roll twice, and Jin Zhong pounced at him. The distance was just right, and he repeated his old trick, leaping up suddenly, but this time instead of raising his knees, he raised his elbow and hit Jin Zhong on the side. Likewise, if he hit the target, He Feng was confident that Jin Zhong would completely lose his fighting power.All this happened so fast, in the blink of an eye. No matter how carefully they thought about it before, Jin Zhong couldn't react at all. He just felt that He Feng's elbow followed him as soon as he landed. After all, the fighting consciousness developed over more than thirty years was not comparable to that of a child today.
However, He Feng had no time to be happy, because the roles had begun to be reversed. He Feng became Jin Zhong who was still lying under him, and Wei Ming became the He Feng before. However, even if Wei Ming responded in time, he was still half a beat slower than He Feng. Half a beat was enough for He Feng.
All victory or defeat depends on this. Whoever can hold on to the end of this blow will be able to take the initiative. This is a fatal blow, a decisive blow.
Faced with this blow that was as fast as lightning and as fierce as thunder, He Feng did not roll away as everyone expected, but turned over in the direction of Wei Ming, just lying under Wei Ming's armpit, and then bent his knees to block his chest, as if he wanted to use his bent legs to block the heavy blow that Wei Ming was bound to hit his chest.Faced with He Feng's childish idea, Wei Ming's eyes were full of ridicule, and the corners of his mouth curled up quietly.You are such an ignorant boy. Do you think you can block your elbow this way?So what if he was blocked? How could his bent legs not be hurt at all under this heavy pressure?Even if both sides lose in the end, you will definitely lose!
In comparison, He Feng's eyes were full of solemnity. Although he was indeed stronger than Wei Ming, the physical gap was still a bit big after all. Even if he was a veteran of this technique, even though he knew that his armpits were one of the softer parts of the human body that cannot be exercised, he still had to be alert and cautious.
Finally, Wei Ming's heavy blow came down. Just when Wei Ming touched He Feng's knee, He Feng immediately kicked his legs, straightened his legs and spread them on the ground.In this way, not only the heavy blow from Wei Ming's whereabouts was mitigated, but also there was no harm to Wei Ming himself. This is the "tricks and tricks" that He Feng has researched in many ways. After all, whether it is crawling on the street or rolling in the ring, if you master more tricks, you can be invincible.Of course, the highest state of being in an invincible position is to keep pressing the enemy and beat him until he falls to the ground. But "I always walk by the river, and my shoes don't get wet." If I can't protect myself, the person who is pressed and beaten will ruthlessly become myself. No, He Feng is the one who is being pressed and beaten now.
"Ah!" Wei Ming only felt that his armpits were burning as if they had been burned by fire. For a moment, he couldn't use any strength on this half of his body, so he had to lie on the ground.
"Hmph!" Although He Feng was not as hurt as Wei Ming, he couldn't help but let out a loud groan. However, he was not injured at all. However, after this series of battles of wits and courage, He Feng's mind and physical strength were greatly depleted. But the current situation did not allow for rest. You know, the fat man was still being beaten there. Now He Feng could only take a few deep breaths, adjust his condition, and immediately sat up.Of course He Feng knew that it would be extremely difficult to get up even if he just took a short break at such an extremely tiring moment.
He Feng's legs curled up again, and Wei Ming immediately cried out in pain and rolled down. In order to absolutely ensure that Wei Ming would not participate in the fight again, He Feng stood up and kicked the side of his body that he had hit with his knee several times. If he hadn't finally remembered that there was a referee watching next to him, he would probably have wanted to strangle Wei Ming to death as he did the day before yesterday. Show it to Jin Can and Yun Hongfei.
Ignoring Wei Ming, who was rolling on the ground and crying out in pain, he walked straight towards the last two people. In fact, the three people there had been paying attention to the fighting situation on He Feng's side. Jin Can and Yun Hongfei had also wanted to come over for a long time, but they were helpless because Li Chun seemed to be dying today and was clinging to them, not letting them have a chance to go away. Of course, they were very angry at Li Chun who had suddenly become so difficult to deal with!I think back then, the six of us punched and kicked the fat man casually, but we didn't see him being so difficult to deal with. But now he actually delayed the two of them for a long time. Until the battle over there was over, the fat man here was still standing strong. How could they not be anxious or angry?!
Tomorrow we will continue with three updates, asking for votes, asking for votes, asking for votes again
